ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Limited's subsidiary, Powerpulse Trading Solutions Limited (PTSL), has secured a significant 25-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with MSEDCL for the supply of 2,500 MW Round-the-Clock (RTC) power, following an internal assignment of the Letter of Award from Adani Power Limited. This material agreement is expected to substantially strengthen PTSL's power supply portfolio and reinforce its position in the energy solutions business. A potential red flag exists in the undisclosed terms of the intra-group LOA assignment from Adani Power to PTSL, raising questions about the transaction's rationale despite the ultimate PPA being with a third party.
